svg.title: Campus Cards · Set 01 · Santa Barbara · 08/12 The Roundabout (Common)
svg.desc: Bike traffic circles. Counterclockwise, no stopping, trust the flow. Unofficial. An independent PointCast art project about places. Not affiliated with, sponsored by, or endorsed by the University of California or any campus. No university logos, seals, mascots, or marks are used.
